content: Epeso yacno Pabado abëd icquido tabadaid

Codinto yacno Apodos icnubi Pabado nidaid Pidiquia caid yacnoësh puduanec podquedën choec macuësh dapa dectatocuëtsenec shubu dadpen icquid Epeso caid yacno choapanëdash. Ambo choshon Esuquidistu tantiaquido istuidshun:
—¿Esuquidistu tantiaquido icshoda Nuquin Papan aton Mayan mibitedi menepanëdash? —capanëdash Pabadon. Adoaquien: —Nuquin Papan Mayan iquec, quequin tantiamboccombi —quepanëdash Epeso yacnocquido.
Adoaquien Pabado: —¿Atotsi canuen mibi acten mentobampanëdash? —quepanëdash. Adoaquien: —Uan padon chiaid tantiaquid icsho acten mentondashi —quepanëdash Epeso yacnocquido Pabado chiec.
Adoaquien: —Mibi icsaid ënta, queshun abimbo tantiaquidtedi acten mentobanquin, Ëbi tsibanec choquid Esus tantiaquid icta, quequin Uan padon chuipanëdash —quepanëdash Pabado Epeso yacnocquido chiec.
Aden chiac, Esuquidistu tantiaquid nebi, quequin Epeso yacnocquidon chuisho tantiashun padpiden acten mentomepanëdash.

Aden aidtedi acten mentoacsho mëdanten Pabadon mamishbanac aid doseted Nuquin Papan aton Mayan menepanëdash. Aden meniac abi onquiacmaidënquio onquec Nuquin Papa chiec cuëdëmpanëdash Epeso yacnocquido.

Adashic Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibante shubun puduedshun Pabadon Nuquin Papabëd tabadaid chuibampanëdash. Cuembo tantiamenuequin ushë choaid 3ted nidmequin badiadquidën-badiadquidënquien dacuëdenquiocquin Nuquin Papan chiaid Pabadon chuibampanëdash.

Aden chuisho tantiash pamumëdacbimboec tabadquin, Tantiatiapibi, quequin utsin-utsinquien chieshëmënquioquin Esuquidistu icsamboen chuipanëdash. Aden chiac Esuquidistu tantiaquidobëd Pabado, Nidnu, quianec Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibante shubu yacnoësh puduanec nidec Tidano cuëmëdquidën chuibante shubu yacno choshon adomboembidi tantiamenuen matsesbëd onquequin Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibampanëdash.

Seta daëd matamequin adomboembi chuibampanëdash Pabadon. Aden chuibansho tantiash nidaneshun chiac nidaid Asia caid yacnocquidon tantiapanëdash. Adoac isadaidbobëd isadaidpembo Esus tantiaquido yampanëdash.
Epeso yacno Pabado tabadsho Nuquin Papan nadatiambocquid icmiacsho

Pabadon dada cuëscashun dashcute cuëshë buanshun daicsaid mishbanac bëdampanëdash. Adembidi Pabadon dada cuëscabanaidën nënquid mishac bëdampanëdash. Adembidi pashuaidtsen pamishac bëdanoapanëdash. Adembidi mishac mayan icsa dapuduempanëdash.
Adnubien mayan icsa dapuduemenuen Pabadon chiacpaden tanquin isadaidbo utsibon: —Esus Pabadon chuiboedënquio dapuduen —capanëdash.
Pabado tanuequido isadaidbo chuiquid Esqueba cuëmëdquidën mado 7ted icpanëdash.
Aden chiaquien mayan icsa: —Esus iquec, quequin ëmbi tantiaid aidi nec. Pabado iquec, quequin ëmbi tantiaidbidi aidi nec. ¿Mibitedi tsutsi neque? Tantianu. Chui
—queshun nebudquin dashcute ched-chedcapamboen mayan icsan cuesactaniaqui shubu nuntanuësh puduenanec cuempanëdash Esqueban mado.
Adec cuensho isquidon chiac Epeso yacnocquid isadaidbobëd isadaidpembo dacuëdcuededpanëdash. Adec dacuëdquin, Dacuëdampambo iquec. Esuquidistu bëdambocquid nec, quequin tantiabededpanëdash.
Esuquidistu tantiesa icboedi Esuquidistu tantiaquid yanec dacuëdenquio yec Esuquidistu tantiaquido iccuededacno nidshun abi icsaid chuibampanëdash.

Adquid dadpenshun icsamenuen ambi ompoquin naid ismenquiocboedombi, Nëbi adquid ictiapibi, quequin cuëte dëtsiadotanquin ambi ompoquin tantiamiaid dada uatetedi tantianuen bedash utsitsen icsabudnushe queshun abitedi tauipanëdash. Aden tauiboed menequin piucquid dadpen bedtsiandac, quepanëdash.
Aden abi icsaid dada uate tauisho isquidon chuibanac Esuquidistu tantiaquid dadpen yampanëdash.

Adashien Pabado: —Edusaden yacno nidnuequin nidaid Masedonia caid yacnocquido isbidanquin nidaid Acaya caid yacnocquidotsen isbidanec nidec Edusaden yacno choash tabadashic shubu dadpen icquid Doma caid yacnotsen nidtiadquio iquebi —quepanëdash Pabado.
Aden chiash Asia caid yacno abi tabadquin Masedonia caid yacno abia Timoteyobëdta Edasto nidmepanëdash Pabadon.
Aid daëdi nidan Epeso yacno tabadquin Esuquidistu Pabadon chuibanaquien tantiesabo nëishpanëdash.
Adquid Demetedio cuëmëdquid Diana caidbimboecnuc nacnemequid icpanëdash. Aidëmbi ambi nacnemiaid menequin piucquid dadpen bedbampanëdash.

Aden Esuquidistu tantianu quesa icquin ambi Dianabimboecnuc nacnenta caidobëdta abipadquid Diana nacnemequid utsibo iccuededmeshun Demetedion nadopanëdash: —Nuqui tantiaid Dianabimboecnuc nacnenshun menequin piucquid dadpen nuqui bedbanec.

Aden nanubi nidaid utsi yacnoësh Pabado cuëmëdquid nëmbo choshon utsi comapenen chuibanac Epeso yacnocquid dadpembëdtan nidaid Asia caid yacnocquid dadpenshun tantiec. Dianabimboecnuc nacnenaid tiboquesa iquec. Adquid matsesën tantiaid abimbo ictiapimbo iquec, quequin Pabadon chiec.

Aden chiac matses dadpenshun tantiash Dianabimboecnuc nacnenquido icsambo iquec, quetsiash ëbitedi caic. Adecbidi, Dianabimboecnuc nacnenaidbëd abi tabadte shubu uashunaid icsambo iquec, queoapec. Adecbidi Dianabimboecnuc nacnenaid tiboquesa icsho matsesën tantienquio ictiadquidi nec, queoapec Pabado. Aden chiac nidaid Asia yacnocquidon dadpenshun Diana tantiaboedombi padenquio yampec. Aidëmbi tantienquio yanshun aidbimboecnuc nuqui nacnenaid bedenquio iquendac —quepanëdash Demetedio.

Aden chiac ambi chomeboedtedi, Piucquid ëbi menequin ëmbi nacnenaid matsesën padpiden bedenquio ictsiash, quec nëishash: —Epeso yacnocquidon tantiaid Diana bëdambo iquec —quec comapenec cuëdcuededpanëdash.

Adec comapenec cuëdcuededsho tantiash Epeso yacnocquid utsibo aidobëd cuëdcuededpanëdash. Adec cuëdcuededquin nidaid Masedonia caid yacnoësh Pabadobëd choboed Cayobëdta Adistadico bedshun iccuededte shubu yacno cuëdcuededquidon buampanëdash.
Aden aid daëd bedshun buansho isquidën chiac Pabado, Iccuededte shubu yacno nidnu, quesho tantiashun: —Padi. Ambo nidenda —capanëdash Esuquidistu tantiaquidon.
Adembidi, anocquido chuiquid utsin-utsinquien Pabado chuioapanëdash.
Adnubien cuëdcuededquidon Cayobëdta Adistadico bedshun buansho isash matses dadpen, ¿Atotsieshun aid daëdi bëo? quequin tantienquio yec tabadpanëdash.
Adnubien, Nuqui tantiacpadomboen chuitan, quequin isadaidbon Adecandedo cuëmëdquid nënantanquio tsicunepanëdash. Aden tsicunequien nidtoash: —Tantia. Chuinu —quequin

daëdpactsëc chiec onquesho tantiash onqueboedi ënëdash tabadnubi: —Isadaidbo aid nec —quesho tantiash: —Epeso yacnocquidon Diana cain ambi tantiaidbimboecnuc nacnenaid bëdambo iquec —quec baded-badedquiec cuëdcuededpanëdash.

Adec cuëdcuededshobien Epeso yacnocquidon naden nata quequin chiaid dada uaquidën ënëdmenuequin nadopanëdash: —Epeso yacnocquidon tantiata. Chuinu. Diana caidbimboecquid abucuësh paëdaidbimboecnuc nacnenaid nuqui comapenen tantiaidbëdta abi tabadte isquido nuqui nec. Adquid Epeso yacnocquido nec, quequin nidaid utsi yacnocquidon tantiec.
Aden utsibon tantiec, quequin tantiaquin icsamboen nainda.
Dada daëd mimbi nëmbo bëboed Diana caidën shubun puduedamboccosh. Adembidi ampiambo iccosh. Adecbidi, Diana caid chiec icsamboec onquenquioccosh.
Adenquio icnuc Demetediobëd icquido abi chushquiaid chuinuec Epeso yacnocquidon naden nata quequin chiaid tantiaquid yacno nidshun
mimbi tantiacpaden chuita cuëdcuededenquiocquin.

Comapenec cuëdcuededec quesho tantiash ancanquid dapan Epeso yacnocquido bëdamboen tabadmeta caid yacno nidshun chiac, Ancanquid dapan chiacpadec Epeso yacnocquido tabadenquio iqueque. Cuëdcuededquido chome, nuqui catsiash. Aden chomiac ¿atotsi nuqui chuipe?
Aidën nuqui chomenushe quiash min shubuno nidaneta —capanëdash Epeso yacnocquidon naden nata quequin chiaid dada uaquidën. Aden chiac Demetediobëd iccuededquido nidanepanëdash.
